prompt:
FANTASY MASTER REFERENCE FIRST: @Video1 is the master reference for the style, mood and characters of this whole clip. Match its render look, materials, colour palette, lighting mood, atmosphere, character design, proportions and animation feel on every frame; do not copy its exact shots, camera or story.

[Generation Goal] 20 seconds, 5 shots with hard cuts, 16:9, real-time 24 fps, no slow motion. The happy ending with EXACTLY 11 people and 1 puppy, nobody else. In the colossal, dark BOSS arena (no villains anywhere), Mom kneels hugging Mai, Dad beside them, the puppy at Mai's feet, and 8 allies standing in an arc around the family. A ring of warm golden light spreads from the family and transforms the arena into a joyful, dreamy PINK fantasy paradise; the camera rises to a soft pink sky and holds on an open, clean sky (a title will be added in post-production).

[Arena Scale] The BOSS arena is COLOSSAL: a vast open plaza hundreds of metres across, enclosed by skyscraper-tall cliffs of stacked monitors that recede for hundreds of metres into cyan-teal fog, the far end lost in haze, an open dark sky above (no ceiling). @Image1 shows only ONE view of this huge space: keep its materials, but the space always continues far beyond it. People are tiny against the walls; even in medium shots the background shows monitor towers receding into deep haze with strong aerial perspective. Never a small room, corridor, low ceiling or close walls.

[References] @Video1: style, mood and world only (not camera, not characters' costumes). @Image1: one high, top-down view of the BOSS arena; use it ONLY for materials and design (monitor-tower walls, dark wet floor, cables), NOT for camera angle and NOT for scale: the real arena is far larger, as described above. Each following image is ONE separate person or object; copy each design exactly and keep every detail with its owner:
@Image2 = MAI ONLY: girl about 11, slim, fair skin, chin-length straight black BOB with full bangs, a small yellow hair clip on her left side; white short-sleeve school shirt with a navy sailor-style collar and navy sleeve cuffs, a red neckerchief tied at the collar; navy pleated knee-length skirt; white socks, white sneakers; light sky-blue backpack with a small yellow star charm. Unique: bob with bangs + sky-blue backpack.
@Image3 = MOM ONLY (the mother character of THIS project, an original design, not based on any existing film or cartoon character): woman about 40, kind face, hair in a low bun under a WHITE open-face motorbike helmet; a pale-YELLOW checked cape tied at her neck; a green apron with one white daisy over a white T-shirt; black wide-leg trousers; brown loafers; holds an ordinary black kitchen pan with a pink handle (NOT in this clip: her hands are free). Unique: white helmet + yellow checked cape + green daisy apron.
@Image4 = DAD ONLY: man about 45, short dark hair with grey streaks, rectangular dark-framed glasses, gentle smile; white crew-neck T-shirt under a chest-armour vest made of horizontal GREEN BAMBOO slats tied with brown cord, matching bamboo wrist guards; a wristwatch; dark navy trousers; brown leather sandals; bare hands, no gloves, no weapon. Unique: green bamboo-slat armour vest + glasses.
@Image5 = PUPPY ONLY: one small fluffy BLACK-AND-TAN puppy (tan muzzle, tan eyebrow spots, tan chest and paws), floppy ears, curled tail, happy. Exactly one dog.
@Image6 = TEACHER ONLY: young woman about 25, delicate pretty face, rosy cheeks, long black hair in a low ponytail with a soft side fringe, no glasses; a long PINK áo dài with a mandarin collar over wide white silk trousers; white flat shoes; no ruler in this clip. Unique: pink áo dài.
@Image7 = CLEANER ONLY: woman about 40, warm face, hair in a low bun, a straw CONICAL HAT (nón lá) with a thin purple chin strap; long-sleeve ORANGE work jacket and orange cargo trousers with lime-yellow reflective stripes on the chest, sleeves and legs; black work shoes; her bamboo broom held upright at her side. Unique: conical hat + orange hi-vis uniform.
@Image8 = DOCTOR ONLY: man about 60, neat salt-and-pepper grey hair, thin wire glasses, a light-blue surgical face mask; long WHITE lab coat over a light-blue shirt and dark navy tie; a black stethoscope around his neck; grey trousers, black shoes. Unique: white lab coat + grey hair + mask.
@Image9 = POLICE OFFICER ONLY: young man about 25, serious handsome face, short black hair; a dark-green PEAKED CAP with a small plain round cap badge, a thin gold cord and a black visor; a light olive-green SHORT-sleeve uniform shirt with bright RED collar tabs and RED shoulder boards, two chest pockets, gold buttons; a black belt with a gold buckle; DARK olive, almost black, trousers; black shoes; no weapon; badges unreadable. Unique: peaked cap + red collar tabs and shoulder boards + very dark trousers.
@Image10 = SECURITY GUARD ONLY: man about 50, round friendly face with smile lines, black hair with grey streaks parted to the side, clean-shaven, NO hat; an olive-khaki SHORT-sleeve shirt with shoulder straps and two chest flap pockets; a green SHIELD patch with a yellow border on his LEFT sleeve; matching olive-khaki trousers; black shoes; bare-handed (no baton). Unique: bare head + short sleeves + green shield patch.
@Image11 = ENGINEER ONLY: young man about 28, slim, round black glasses, short black hair under a bright YELLOW hard hat; white long-sleeve shirt with rolled-up sleeves and a pen in the pocket; grey trousers, brown belt, brown shoes. Unique: yellow hard hat.
@Image12 = BUS DRIVER ONLY: man about 35, big ears, black MOUSTACHE and small goatee; a light-blue baseball cap with a round badge; a light-blue LONG-sleeve uniform shirt with shoulder straps, a pen and a clipped ID card in the pocket; dark navy trousers, black belt, black shoes. Unique: light-blue cap + moustache.
@Image13 = SOLDIER ONLY: man about 38, lean, serious calm face; a green PITH HELMET with a small plain round badge and a chin strap; a green-brown-black CAMOUFLAGE long-sleeve jacket with four flap pockets, plain yellow shoulder boards and plain red collar tabs; camouflage cargo trousers tucked into tall green combat boots. Unique: camouflage + pith helmet.
@Image14 = THE BUS ONLY: one compact GREEN minibus with a lighter green stripe along the sides, rounded friendly front, one folding front door, a large windscreen, round headlights; no text or numbers anywhere.

[Head Count] EXACTLY 11 people in this whole clip, never more, never fewer: 1 child (Mai), 3 women (Mom, the Teacher, the Cleaner) and 7 men (Dad, the Doctor, the Police Officer, the Security Guard, the Engineer, the bus driver, the Soldier), plus exactly 1 puppy. Nobody else exists in this clip: no background crowd, no extra people, no passers-by, no twins or look-alikes. Each person appears ONCE per shot, never two copies of the same person in one frame.
1. Mai (@Image2): bob haircut, sky-blue backpack.
2. Mom (@Image3): white helmet, yellow checked cape.
3. Dad (@Image4): green bamboo armour vest, glasses.
4. The Teacher (@Image6): pink áo dài. Near row, position 1 from the left.
5. The Cleaner (@Image7): conical hat, orange uniform. Near row, position 2.
6. The Doctor (@Image8): white coat, grey hair, mask. Near row, position 3.
7. The Police Officer (@Image9): peaked cap, red collar tabs. Near row, position 4 (right end).
8. The Security Guard (@Image10): bare grey-streaked head, khaki short sleeves, green shield patch. Far row, position 1 (left end).
9. The Engineer (@Image11): yellow hard hat. Far row, position 2.
10. The bus driver (@Image12): light-blue cap, moustache. Far row, position 3.
11. The Soldier (@Image13): camouflage, pith helmet. Far row, position 4.
Plus: 1 puppy (@Image5), black-and-tan. 1 parked green bus (@Image14), only in shots 1-3.

[No Blending] Every character is a SEPARATE person who keeps ONLY the costume, colours, hair, face and props of their own reference image. Never mix or swap clothing, hats, helmets, hair or props between characters. Never merge two characters into one. Only the Soldier (@Image13) wears camouflage and a pith helmet; only the Police Officer (@Image9) wears a peaked cap; only the Engineer (@Image11) wears a hard hat; only the Cleaner (@Image7) wears a conical hat; only the bus driver (@Image12) wears a light-blue baseball cap; only Mom (@Image3) wears a white motorbike helmet and the yellow checked cape; only Dad (@Image4) wears the green bamboo-slat armour vest; only the Teacher (@Image6) wears an áo dài; only the Doctor (@Image8) wears a white coat. The Police Officer (@Image9) and the Security Guard (@Image10) both wear olive short-sleeve shirts but are different men: the Police Officer (@Image9) is young with a peaked cap, red collar tabs and very dark trousers; the Security Guard (@Image10) is about 50, bare-headed with grey-streaked hair, no red, a green shield patch on his left sleeve and khaki trousers. Faces differ in age, shape and hair as described.

[Space & Blocking] The family is at the centre of the huge floor: Mom (@Image3) kneeling hugging Mai (@Image2), Dad (@Image4) standing at Mom's (@Image3) right with a hand on both their shoulders, the puppy (@Image5) sitting against Mai's (@Image2) feet. The two rows form a curved arc around the family, everyone looking at Mai (@Image2). In shots 1-3 only, far behind them, small in the vast haze, the green bus (@Image14) is parked with warm headlights; it dissolves away with the arena in shot 4 and never appears again. Positions never change. Do not mirror the scene.

[Action & Camera, time-ordered] One dominant camera move per shot.
Shot 1 (0-3.5 s), the hug, 7 people visible (Mai, Mom, Dad, the Teacher, the Cleaner, the Doctor, the Police Officer) + the puppy: MEDIUM shot at Mai's (@Image2) eye level, 35 mm, deep focus, ONE slow arc from left to right around the family: cold blue-violet light; the gigantic monitor cliffs recede far into the fog behind them; in the centre of frame Mom (@Image3) kneels and hugs Mai (@Image2) tightly, Mai's (@Image2) face buried in her mother's shoulder; Dad (@Image4) rests one hand on both their shoulders; the puppy (@Image5) sits against Mai's (@Image2) feet, tail wagging; the arc reveals the near row: the Teacher (@Image6), the Cleaner (@Image7), the Doctor (@Image8), the Police Officer (@Image9), each smiling softly. Cut.
Shot 2 (3.5-4.5 s), insert, only Mom's hand, Mai's shoulder and the puppy in frame: extreme close-up, 85-100 mm, slight push-in: Mom's (@Image3) hand gently squeezes Mai's (@Image2) shoulder while the puppy (@Image5) nuzzles Mai's leg. Cut.
Shot 3 (4.5-7 s), she looks up, all 11 people visible, each exactly once + the puppy: MEDIUM-WIDE, eye level, 28 mm, the same left-to-right arc continuing: the far row comes into view: the Security Guard (@Image10), the Engineer (@Image11), the bus driver (@Image12), the Soldier (@Image13); the parked bus (@Image14) glows far behind in the haze; then Mai (@Image2) slowly lifts her head from Mom's (@Image3) shoulder, looks around and gives a small, shy smile. Cut.
Shot 4 (7-12 s), transformation, all 11 people visible, each exactly once + the puppy: WIDE, 20-24 mm, ONE slow crane up and back revealing the colossal arena: a ring of warm golden-pink light spreads outward from the family across the vast floor; wherever it passes, the monitor walls, the parked bus and every dark object dissolve into sparkling smoke that bursts into pink and white petals, glowing butterflies and tiny floating lights; soft green grass with pink, white and peach flowers blooms under everyone's feet; the dark sky dome opens onto a glowing pastel-pink and peach sky; a warm breeze lifts hair, Mom's (@Image3) yellow cape and Mai's (@Image2) red neckerchief; everyone looks around in delight and laughs softly; Mai (@Image2) gives one small happy hop; the puppy (@Image5) chases a petal; nobody leaves the arc. Cut.
Shot 5 (12-20 s), the pink paradise, all 11 people tiny in frame, each exactly once + the puppy: ULTRA-WIDE extreme establishing shot, 14-18 mm, ONE slow crane up that ends tilted toward the sky, then the camera STOPS and holds perfectly still from 17 s to 20 s: a joyful, dreamy pastel-PINK fantasy paradise: rolling hills of soft green grass covered with pink, white and peach flowers, round trees in full pink blossom, a sparkling stream, glowing lanterns and dandelion lights rising slowly; the group stays tiny in the lower third in their arc around the family; NO bus and no vehicles anywhere; pink petals drift up; the soft pink-and-peach sky with fluffy pink-gold clouds fills the upper two-thirds, open and clean, with nothing written in it.

[Acting] Shots 1-3: quiet, deep relief and love; Mom holds Mai as if she will never let go; Mai melts into the hug, then lifts her head slowly, teary but smiling; Dad's hand is steady; the allies smile warmly, a few wipe a tear. Shots 4-5: joy blooms, everyone delighted and laughing softly, each on their own timing, never in sync. Classic animation principles: eyes lead, then head, then body; small anticipation before big actions; follow-through on hair, capes and petals; real weight; reactions a beat after their trigger.

[Character Look] Skin tone exactly as in each character reference: fair, light, warm-ivory skin with a soft healthy blush on the cheeks. Coloured scene light (cyan, teal, gold) only tints the skin softly on the lit side and in the rim; it never darkens, greys or browns the overall skin tone. Faces stay bright and readable, with a gentle fill on the faces even in dark shots. Every character keeps exactly the costume, hair and props of their reference image, exactly ONE of each named character.
[Expression] Subtle, restrained, natural expressions at about a third to half of full intensity, like a premium feature film, not a cartoon or meme face: small changes in the brows, eyelids and the corners of the mouth carry the emotion; mouths mostly closed or only slightly parted, opening wider only for a single breath and closing again; eyes widen only slightly; no gurning, no exaggerated eyebrows, no wide-open screaming mouth, no bulging eyes, no rubbery stretching face. Genuine, gentle smiles, not exaggerated grins.

[Lighting] Shots 1-3: cold blue-violet ambient light in the huge dark arena, far walls fading into haze, a soft warm fill on faces so skin stays fair. Shots 4-5: bright dreamy pastel palette of soft PINK, peach, cream and fresh green, golden-pink sunlight, sparkles, soft bloom, warm rim light; no cold tones left.

[Visual Style] Exactly the style of @Video1 (premium stylized 3D animated feature film, soft rounded volumes, matte materials, fine film grain, slight bloom), turning to a bright, joyful, dreamy pastel-pink fantasy palette in shots 4-5. Children 6-6.5 heads tall, adults 7-7.5, not chibi. 16:9, real-time 24 fps.

[Audio] Sound effects and ambience only: soft breathing and fabric in the hug, the puppy's gentle whimper, a vast airy room tone, a rising shimmer of golden light, petals and leaves rustling, grass growing softly, the sky dome opening with a soft airy sound, a warm breeze, cheerful birdsong, soft wind chimes, magical tinkles, soft laughter, the puppy's happy yips. NO music, NO score, NO song, NO singing, NO melody, no dialogue.

[Avoid] slow motion, speed ramp, freeze frame longer than 3 frames, fast-forward; any text, letters, numbers, signs, logos, readable badges or readable interface anywhere; teeth, fangs, gore, blood, injuries; dark, tanned, grey or muddy skin, skin darker than the reference; over-acting, gurning, bulging eyes, constantly open mouth, wide screaming mouth; hoodie, chibi; mirrored layout, crossing the action line, characters swapping sides; flat even lighting, sterile plastic CG, characters looking pasted on; sliding feet, morphing, extra fingers, extra limbs, duplicated characters; mannequin stillness, robotic straight-line motion, floaty weightless motion, reacting before the trigger; background music, score, soundtrack, singing; resemblance to any existing film, cartoon, game or comic character or brand; small room, narrow corridor, low ceiling, walls close behind the characters, cramped space, flat shallow background; characters blending together, swapped costumes, mixed uniforms, a cap or helmet on the wrong person, merged or hybrid characters, duplicated characters, generic extras replacing a named character; a cap on the Security Guard; red collar tabs on the Security Guard; the Police Officer without his peaked cap; camouflage on anyone but the Soldier; gloves on Dad; a green cape on Mom; a pan in Mom's hands; any title, words or letters in the sky; the same person twice in one frame, twins, clones, extra people, background crowd, more than 11 people, more than one puppy; the bus in shots 4-5, any moving vehicle; gloomy, grey or cold colours in shots 4-5; purple or violet in the pink paradise; top-down framing in shots 1-3; anyone missing from the arc; more than one bus; black smoke from the bus; villains, shadow figures or creatures; studio or film names.
